# wellbeing Provider

Manage HR.ON Wellbeing (previously howdy.care) resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    wellbeing = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/techchapter/wellbeing"
    }
  }
}

# host defaults to https://api-ne1.worklifebarometer.com/
# Every attribute may also be supplied via the environment:
#   WELLBEING_HOST, WELLBEING_TOKEN, WELLBEING_COMPANY_ID
provider "wellbeing" {
  token      = var.wellbeing_token
  company_id = var.wellbeing_company_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) Company ID for the Wellbeing API. May also be provided via the WELLBEING_COMPANY_ID environment variable.
- `host` (String) Base URI for the Wellbeing API. Defaults to https://api-ne1.worklifebarometer.com/. May also be provided via the WELLBEING_HOST environment variable.
- `max_retries` (Number) Number of times a retryable request failure is re-attempted. Defaults to 3.
- `request_timeout` (String) Timeout for a single HTTP request, as a Go duration string. Defaults to 5m. A full roster replace carrying thousands of employees needs a generous value.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the Wellbeing API, issued to a user with the HRIntegration role. May also be provided via the WELLBEING_TOKEN environment variable.
